title: Unit Event — Same Dreams, Same Colors — Episode6 What We Each Can Do

meta.Episode: Episode6 — What We Each Can Do
meta.Event Outline: Kohane and the rest of VBS continue practicing in pursuit of greater growth. However, Toya finds himself struggling to understand the vision that his teammates have for a song due to his lack of life experience. That's when Luka offers some advice!

rows.Line: Campground

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, how about we practice building a campfire for making dinner now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A lighter's usually faster, but I'd like to use matches this time around...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, then let's start gathering up some firewood.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're supposed to look for very dry wood, yes?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! Let's see what we can find!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
We've gathered quite a lot.
What comes next?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We'll need to separate these branches by size. Then, you stack them like this and...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
There, all done.
Wanna try lighting it, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. It's always more fun when you do it yourself.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Start by lighting the tinder. Those are the really small twigs, and they'll help light the bigger branches.
se_event_camp_2021_004

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay, the tinder's lit.
Now to light the kindling...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Keep in mind that it won't stay lit forever...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. I'll be careful... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It went out before I could light anything else... Why is that...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, the wind may be too much for it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Why don't we do this...?
Can you guys help me find some rocks? They'll need to be more or less the size of your fist.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Rocks?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, that should be enough to line our pit... Aoyagi, mind giving it another try?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I can't make any guarantees.
Light the tinder and...
se_event_camp_2021_004

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Everything lit properly this time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The rocks protect it against the wind.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
All that's left is to give it some air...
Try blowing on it like this...
se_event_camp_2021_003

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, it grew.
That's incredible.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Now I see. You need to be able to think on your feet. I definitely stand to learn quite a lot from this experience.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Next, it's my turn!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Camping equals barbeque!
So let's chop everything up and put them on skewers!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Do we need to rinse the vegetables before we chop them?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa, Toya, have you ever used a knife before...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No. I was only ever allowed to peel onions and such during home ec, so I'll be using a kitchen knife for the first time today...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's okay. Just stay relaxed and you'll be fine. As far as I can tell, there's nothing wrong with the way you're holding everything.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How about you start with some bell peppers?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay.
How big should they be?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... I usually just eyeball it... But we're making skewers, so how about quarters? Try chopping them in half and again after that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Quarters...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, chill.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, Aoyagi, just try to relax...!
As long as you curl your fingers in while you chop, your fingers will be fine.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Grr... That's easier said than done in my case... I can't get as good a grip on them...
se_event_camp_2021_001
se_event_camp_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I did it...!
Shiraishi, I did it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, nice job!
You're actually pretty good at this, Toya!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Keep up the good work and chop away!
se_event_camp_2021_002

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Akito, mind making me some bowls out of foil? I wanna try sauteing the end piece of the veggies in garlic oil.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That sounds amazing.
Just gimme a sec.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, didn't one of us bring some cheese? We could use some foil to make a fondue bowl.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, nice idea!
Let's give it a shot!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, can you start putting Toya's veggies onto skewers for us?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Quarters... Quarters...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Aoyagi!
Your onion's gonna fall apart if you chop it like that!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
*Sigh*...
Finally, we're done prepping for dinner...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! The last step is for us to cook everything, so we can relax and have fun until dinnertime!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank goodness too. For a second there, I was worried that it'd get dark before we could finish pitching our tents and getting ready for dinner!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But we should be able to check out the forest before we eat now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Let's go take a look.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we need to be careful about getting lost. Does the GPS on our phones work out here...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I made sure to check after my sister told me about what happened when she and her friends went out hiking the other day.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm getting a decent signal, which means the GPS should be working fine.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Great! We have nothing to worry about! Lemme just put out the fire... Okay, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This feels so strange...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (All I did during elementary and junior high school was watch while everyone had fun during school events.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I'm able to enjoy and experience all those activities now.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I couldn't be more grateful...)
<Toya!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<It's me, Luka♪
So, are you enjoying the forest?>
bgm_area00003

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We were just about to go take a look. Actually, I've had quite a bit of fun already...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We pitched our tents, built a campfire and all these other things that I never got to experience before...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Really? Good for you!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <What's wrong?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's just... I'm having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'm the only one that's never done any of this before. It became a reminder of how little I'm actually able to do...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I didn't know how to pitch a tent, build a campfire or even chop vegetables properly...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I think you're selling yourself too short.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I believe everyone possesses some sort of “unique talent”.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes. I know because I've seen yours firsthand.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Your ears and vast musical knowledge allow the others to feel at ease.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <What you're doing now is no different. I have a feeling that you'll find what you're good at once you've had a chance to learn the basics.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, Luka...

rows.Speaker: Akito's Voice
rows.Line:
Hey, Toya!
What's the hold up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: S-Sorry...! Luka just...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, don't mind me.
Go have fun with your friends.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You should be enjoying every second of this moment!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right...
Again, thank you.
